verdict.rationale: AutoGen's code executor defaults to spinning up a fresh Docker container per execution, giving genuine sandboxed execution, and this is corroborated by hands-on community reports, not just docs. However, there is no evidence of fine-grained per-tool permissioning (e.g., allow/deny lists, scoped capabilities per agent) beyond generically attaching tools to an AssistantAgent. missing for 10: documented fine-grained tool-permission/allowlist system, first-party guidance on restricting which tools an agent may call, and independent verification of permission enforcement.
